title: Adds a license, if the business wants (optional)
does: Add any license, insurance or document you want shown (optional). Rosie shows it as you gave it and doesn't check it. Skipping is fine.
more: Insurance or a bond may be added here too, the same way (optional).
Each person may add their own license after their invite (optional), by text or a call, or on the secure page.
Never: let a license stand for control (S1-75), say Rosie checked it, or make it required.
Safe default: nothing added, and the work goes on.

rule: Rosie's rule: a license, insurance or document is optional, shown as given and never checked; nothing waits on it. Each person is offered once the owner says yes. Why: Rosie can't vouch for a paper, so it never claims to.
